previous_story: Deep in the Arctic, Maya repaired the frozen solar tower. Her fingers slipped, dropping her torch into the dark ravine. Suddenly, a warm hand caught her wrist. She turned to see a man in an antique diver’s helmet floating weightlessly. His glowing eyes locked onto hers through the visor. He placed an old brass pocket watch in her palm. 'I promised I'd find you,' he whispered. Come back for the next part tomorrow.
